support_claim: Contract MSA-MER-2024 names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, billing records bill that same legal name, and commercial notes state Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under that contract.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet provides establishing evidence—not mere compatibility—that the billing referent and the contract referent resolve to the same legal counterparty: the contract header explicitly designates Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, invoices.json records that billed_name, and commercial_notes links Meridian Energy Partners invoicing to MSA-MER-2024; no observation supports distinctness and the packet does not preserve multiple live candidates or state that identity cannot be established.
